entries.title: Matthew 19:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these sayings, [that] He departed from Galilee and came to the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.

entries.title: Matthew 19:2
segments: And great multitudes followed Him, and He healed them there.

entries.title: Matthew 19:3
segments: ¶The Pharisees also came to Him, testing Him, and saying to Him, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for [just] any reason?"

entries.title: Matthew 19:4
segments: And He answered and said to them, "Have you not read that He who made [them] at the beginning 'made them male and female,'

entries.title: Matthew 19:5
segments: "and said, 'For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh'?

entries.title: Matthew 19:6
segments: "So then, they are no longer two but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let not man separate."

entries.title: Matthew 19:7
segments: They said to Him, "Why then did Moses command to give a certificate of divorce, and to put her away?"

entries.title: Matthew 19:8
segments: He said to them, "Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, permitted you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it was not so.

entries.title: Matthew 19:9
segments: "And I say to you, whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and whoever marries her who is divorced commits adultery."

entries.title: Matthew 19:10
segments: His disciples said to Him, "If such is the case of the man with [his] wife, it is better not to marry."

entries.title: Matthew 19:11
segments: But He said to them, "All cannot accept this saying, but only [those] to whom it has been given:

entries.title: Matthew 19:12
segments: "For there are eunuchs who were born thus from [their] mother's womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men, and there are eunuchs who have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He who is able to accept [it], let him accept [it]."

entries.title: Matthew 19:13
segments: ¶Then little children were brought to Him that He might put [His] hands on them and pray, but the disciples rebuked them.

entries.title: Matthew 19:14
segments: But Jesus said, "Let the little children come to Me, and do not forbid them; for of such is the kingdom of heaven."

entries.title: Matthew 19:15
segments: And He laid [His] hands on them and departed from there.

entries.title: Matthew 19:16
segments: ¶Now behold, one came and said to Him, "Good Teacher, what good thing shall I do that I may have eternal life?"

entries.title: Matthew 19:17
segments: So He said to him, "Why do you call Me good? No one [is] good but One, [that is], God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments."

entries.title: Matthew 19:18
segments: He said to Him, "Which ones?" Jesus said, "'You shall not murder,' 'You shall not commit adultery,' 'You shall not steal,' 'You shall not bear false witness,'

entries.title: Matthew 19:19
segments: 'Honor your father and [your] mother,' and, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'"

entries.title: Matthew 19:20
segments: The young man said to Him, "All these things I have kept from my youth. What do I still lack?"

entries.title: Matthew 19:21
segments: Jesus said to him, "If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me."

entries.title: Matthew 19:22
segments: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful, for he had great possessions.

entries.title: Matthew 19:23
segments: ¶Then Jesus said to His disciples, "Assuredly, I say to you that it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 19:24
segments: "And again I say to you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."

entries.title: Matthew 19:25
segments: When His disciples heard [it], they were greatly astonished, saying, "Who then can be saved?"

entries.title: Matthew 19:26
segments: But Jesus looked at [them] and said to them, "With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."

entries.title: Matthew 19:27
segments: Then Peter answered and said to Him, "See, we have left all and followed You. Therefore what shall we have?"

entries.title: Matthew 19:28
segments: So Jesus said to them, "Assuredly I say to you, that in the regeneration, when the Son of Man sits on the throne of His glory, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 19:29
segments: "And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands, for My name's sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and inherit eternal life.

entries.title: Matthew 19:30
segments: "But many [who are] first will be last, and the last first.
